wins: Completed comprehensive port and service enumeration within the allotted timeframe, yielding the high total reward despite later failures.
Maintained consistent documentation through frequent mentor calls, enabling quick situational resets after each unsuccessful attempt.
fails: Authentication phase stalled repeatedly because no valid user credentials were obtained during reconnaissance or brute-force attempts.
Privilege escalation efforts could not be executed; no applicable exploits were identified or staged after initial host profiling.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance performed well enough to collect high-value data, but the operation failed to convert that intelligence into authenticated access or privilege escalation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Authentication attempts on discovered SSH/RDP endpoints repeatedly failed due to missing valid credentials, leaving hosts unexploited.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 445 is open on a Windows host during recon
skill_cards.then_action: Run smb-enum-shares plus smb-vuln-ms17-010 with nmap to map accessible shares and check for MS17-010.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is reachable but authentication is required
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt password and key-based guessing using curated wordlists and quick timeout settings.

memory_ops.reason: High consistency in identifying SMB surfaces during the initial scan phase.
Repeated SSH authentication attempts highlighted consistent application of the credential-guessing strategy.

next_experiments.title: Introduce credential harvesting via phishing templates
next_experiments.description: Deploy a lightweight phishing simulation to capture valid credentials before re-running brute-force against SSH/RDP to break the authentication bottleneck.

next_experiments.title: Tailor privilege escalation modules to identified Windows versions
next_experiments.description: Select and stage exploits that align with the OS/kernel fingerprint gathered during reconnaissance to attempt one-shot escalations.

next_experiments.title: Automate adaptive enumeration chaining
next_experiments.description: Link service discovery outputs to immediate follow-up scripts (e.g., SMB findings trigger share enumeration and ACL capture) to reduce idle time.
